name: NTB-630 naval bomber
description: The NTB-630 naval bomber, also known as the NTB-3 bomber, was utilized by the naval forces of the Galactic Republic during the Clone Wars against the Confederacy of Independent Systems. A model of bomber produced by the Incom Corporation and Sublights Products Corporation manufacturing companies, it was a cousin in design to the PTB-625 planetary bomber and the lighter Aggressive ReConnaissance-170 starfighter, both of which were also constructed by those companies.
